spin-the-bottle.formula:
Player i sits at angle i x (360° ÷ n), measured clockwise from the top.
Winner: index = floor(random() x n) — every player has exactly a 1/n chance.
Animation: final rotation = current angle + (5 to 7) x 360° + the offset that aims the bottle mouth at the winner's angle.
howTo: Type each player's name and press Add (or hit Enter). Add 2 to 12 players.
Remove anyone with the x on their chip — the circle re-balances itself.
Press Spin the Bottle and watch the bottle whirl 5 to 7 full turns before landing.
The bottle stops pointing at the winner, whose chip lights up and whose tally grows by one.
Press Reset Tally anytime to zero the counts without removing players.
keyFacts: Spin the Bottle picks one player at random from a circle of 2 to 12 names.

spin-the-bottle.workedExample:
6 players sit at 0°, 60°, 120°, 180°, 240°, 300°.
1. random() returns 0.72 → index = floor(0.72 x 6) = 4 → the 5th player.
2. Target angle = 4 x 60° = 240°. The bottle sits at 0° and spins 6 full turns.
3. Final rotation = 0 + 6 x 360 + 240 = 2400°. 2400 mod 360 = 240° — the mouth points exactly at player 5, whose tally becomes 1.
